description: Explore the low side of the Muon lr on the new whitening. Polar Express lifts ~95% of singular directions against ~86% for the old NS3, and the output is rescaled to the old Frobenius norm, so the per-direction rotation is smaller and spread more evenly. The lr optimum may have moved. Base: E069. Make one change: Muon lr 0.16 -> 0.12 for the conv filters, with schedule shape, floor, momentum, SGD group, lookahead, curriculum, freeze and epochs all unchanged. The lr is fill_'ed into a 0-d tensor every step, so nothing recompiles.
